message.content:
**MSFT** is the ticker symbol for **Microsoft Corporation** on the stock market.  
In Yahoo Finance, you can view its data by searching for “MSFT” or by visiting:

[https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSFT](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSFT)

This page shows real‑time price, historical charts, financial statements, news, analyst estimates, and other key metrics for Microsoft’s publicly traded shares.
